locations.name: Forest Entrance
locations.description: You stand at the edge of a mysterious forest. A narrow path leads north into the shadows of ancient trees. Beside the path, a weathered sign leans in the undergrowth.

locations.name: Dark Forest
locations.description: Towering, ancient trees block out most of the light here. The air is cold and still. A path leads south back to the forest entrance, east toward the sound of running water, and west toward a crumbling silhouette barely visible through the trees.

locations.name: Old Bridge
locations.description: A weathered wooden bridge spans a narrow ravine. Its planks creak underfoot. Something metallic glints between two loose boards.

locations.name: Forgotten Tower
locations.description: The Forgotten Tower rises before you, its entrance sealed by a heavy, rusted door. Vines and decades of neglect cling to the ancient stone.

items.name: Weathered Sign
items.description: A weathered wooden sign, half-swallowed by moss. Something is carved into it.

items.name: Rusted Bridge Key
items.description: A heavy iron key, rusted but still solid. It looks like it belongs to something old.

npcs.name: The Hermit
npcs.personality: A reclusive old hermit who has watched over the Dark Forest for decades. Wary of strangers but not unkind; speaks in short, cryptic sentences and respects those who show patience.
